title: Hexagon Coaster Set (4)
required: partial_physical (first-customer floor, gates.risk_matrix.first_customer_requirement); the kit is a full make of all four, which satisfies it and is the coaster's one physical claim: it lies flat
cost_basis: ESTIMATED, all-inclusive: tester fee 4.498 h (3.46 h x1.3) at CA$20/h = CA$89.96, plus 2 balls x CA$5.00 = CA$10.00, paid in full (CA$99.96) by a fee-free transfer, leaving CA$0.04 for processing. No tester has been paid yet
yarn_metres_scope: every piece the pattern makes (cir.twin._yardage x make)

materials.quantity: 1 ball (twin: 22.6 m needed for all four; any ball of >= 30 m)
1 ball (twin: 6.2 m needed for all four)

person_needed.who: one independent adult crocheter (not the owner, F-071) who agreed through the tester programme (quality.tester_programme)
person_needed.skill: confident with single crochet in joined rounds from a magic ring, and with increasing at six stacked corners to make a flat hexagon; can read a written pattern in US terms; owns or can borrow a 1 g kitchen scale
person_needed.time: about 3.5-4.5 hours of making (all four coasters) plus 20 minutes of measuring

protocol: Weigh each full ball; record the ball band (grams and metres)
Work a 10 x 10 cm sc swatch; record stitches and rounds per 10 cm and the hook; then RE-WEIGH each ball and use that as its start weight, so the swatch's yarn is not counted as project yarn
Make all FOUR coasters exactly as written; note every guess, re-read or rip-back by round
Weigh what is left; grams used = re-weighed start minus end, per colour, for all four
Measure EACH coaster across the points and across the flats, flat on a table, unstretched, and write all four in their own boxes (cm)
Lay each coaster on a flat table: does it lie flat? If one cups (edges lift) or ruffles (wavy edge), answer no and say which in the problems box
Record total hours (all four, not the swatch) and whether you followed it exactly
Photograph in daylight on a real surface; keep every camera file UNEDITED (no filter, crop, resize or retouch), landscape or square, at least 2000 px each side, with space around

Shots: (1) all four laid flat in a 2 x 2 group, three-quarter angle -- the listing's first photo; (2) one coaster side-on at table level, not pressed down; (3) a ruler across the points; (4) close-up of a corner and the contrast round; (5) a mug on one coaster
Return sheet and photos; the operator enters them (POST /api/physical-test, /api/physical-photo)

covers_size.rule: a sample covers exactly this one size

intake.gate_opens_when: the physical.record job writes a PhysicalTest row with completed_at
intake.outcomes: PASS binds; PARTIAL (not flat, shape not held, a problem recorded) goes to the owner and binds nothing; FAIL binds nothing; a size outside 12% halts this release
